def dil(m, it):
    o = m.copy()
    for _ in range(it):
        n = o.copy()
        n[1:, :] |= o[:-1, :]; n[:-1, :] |= o[1:, :]
        n[:, 1:] |= o[:, :-1]; n[:, :-1] |= o[:, 1:]
        o = n
    return o
